description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 three additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U/B}{B}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate ability by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling token.
Repeat.
